notes: «قال سألت مالك بن أنس» makes Malik the source of Bishr's report (rule 5); he answers («ليس بثقة»), so he is the last link.
The men Malik is asked about (محمد بن عبد الرحمن, صالح, أبو الحويرث, شعبة, حرام) are subjects of the questions, not links; «عن سعيد بن المسيب» sits inside a question.
All the sayings in this report share one chain, so no saying keys.
